4	import argparse
5	import sys
6	from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_CEILING
7	
8	
9	class OneLineParser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
10	    def error(self, message):
11	        raise ValueError(message)
12	
13	
14	def fail(message):
15	    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
16	    return 2
17	
18	
19	def main():
20	    parser = OneLineParser(add_help=True)
21	    parser.add_argument("--mileage", required=True, help="checked mileage in kilometres")
22	    parser.add_argument("--night", required=True, help="yes or no")
23	    try:
24	        args = parser.parse_args()
25	    except ValueError as exc:
26	        return fail(f"無法使用命令列參數：{exc}")
27	
28	    try:
29	        mileage = Decimal(args.mileage)
30	        if not mileage.is_finite():
31	            raise InvalidOperation
32	    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
33	        return fail(f"無法使用 --mileage 的值「{args.mileage}」：必須是檢查器確認的公里數。")
34	
35	    night = args.night.strip().lower()
36	    if night not in ("yes", "no"):
37	        return fail(f"無法使用 --night 的值「{args.night}」：必須是 yes 或 no。")
38	
39	    if mileage <= 0:
40	        print(f"無效（里程 {mileage} 公里不大於 0），不計價。")
41	        return 0

44	    blocks = int((excess / Decimal("0.2")).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING))
45	    fare = 85 + 5 * blocks + (20 if night == "yes" else 0)
